description: GET ONLY the 'Character' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel. Character/hero catalogue — playable units, NPCs, summons. Defines stats, abilities, evolution/level-up paths, art/asset references. Distinct from Item (generic inventory) — characters typically have progression and abilities. Skins (alternative looks) live per character in Skins.Definitions, and each skin IS a non-stackable, non-expiring Item from the Item section (Skins.Definitions.<id>.Item) — create that item first; any system that grants items (Store offers, lootboxes, season, quests, rewards) then grants the skin, and Item.Stats, if set, count toward Power like gear.
name: get_character
title: Get Character settings
